output.body: Worked example on an isomorph, summing 1 to n: sum(n) = 1 if n is 1 (base case, no further call needed), otherwise sum(n) = n + sum(n-1), because n-1 is a smaller version of the same problem and it eventually reaches 1. Tracing sum(3) gives 3 + sum(2), then 3 + 2 + sum(1), then 3 + 2 + 1, which is 6. Now your completion step: for counting down a list's length, the base case is the empty list, which has length 0, and the recursive case needs one piece you fill in.
